item_name: Rothco Neoprene Knee Pad Inserts - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Neoprene Knee Pad Inserts are specially designed to protect law enforcement and public safety professionals in the line of duty. These lightweight tactical knee pads contour to the shape of your knee to provide unbeatable protection from impact.
description: Rothco’s Neoprene Knee Pad Inserts are specially designed to protect law enforcement and public safety professionals in the line of duty. These lightweight tactical knee pads contour to the shape of your knee to provide unbeatable protection from impact. The knee pads are made from a durable and flexible neoprene material with rounded edges that contour to your knee. The tactical knee pads can be cut like shoe insoles for the perfect fit, they also feature four notches for easy form fitting.
